contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' (11,215.93) on the p4 Summary Page — the promoted per-period cell. ⚠ NOT the schedule's own two footers, which on this filing print a figure of a DIFFERENT SCOPE (see detail)
contributions.detail: The 4 written Schedule A rows sum to 901.5 + 2000 + 5000 + 3314.43 = 11,215.93 exactly = Box B, and Box C (Year to Date) prints the identical 11,215.93 and is not summed as an increment. ⚠ THE SCHEDULE'S OWN TWO PRINTED FOOTERS DO NOT CARRY THE CONTRIBUTION FIGURE: both 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' print 11,722.37, which is 506.44 MORE than the rows — and 506.44 is exactly Box A, the balance at beginning of the reporting period. In other words the filer copied Box F ('Subtotal before Expenditures = Box A + Box B', which he also writes as 11,722.37) into Schedule A's two footer lines. The attribution is UNIQUE from the document's own boxes (11,722.37 - 11,215.93 = 506.44 = Box A to the cent), so this is a SCOPE ERROR IN THE FOOTERS, not a missing row and not a row-level delta: the rows themselves close to the cent on the period-scoped cell that matches their scope, which is exactly what the ratified basis rule directs. NOTHING WAS NUDGED and both printed figures are quoted here. Note that on this filing 11,722.37 is ALSO the expenditure total (Box D/E), because the campaign closed at exactly zero (F - D = 0), so which of the two the filer copied cannot be determined and is not adjudicated. The candidate is his own only donor, and the ladder was run before publishing his payments as contribution rows (ADDENDUM B3): Box A is 506.44, a real prior balance that no listed row matches, so the four rows are contributions and none of them is the opening balance.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (11,722.37) on the p4 Summary Page, corroborated by Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 11,722.37' AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report) $ 11,722.37'
expenditures.detail: The 9 written Schedule B rows sum to 901.50 + 2000.00 + 3500.00 + 2000.00 + 51.90 + 461.79 + 762.38 + 2016.80 + 28.00 = 11,722.37 exactly = the page subtotal = the sum-of-all-pages total = the promoted per-period Box D. Box E (YTD) prints the identical figure. This side needs no caveat at all: three independent printed statements of the same figure and the rows reproduce it to the cent. The filing's ladder is fully self-consistent on its own terms: A 506.44 + B 11,215.93 = F 11,722.37, and F - D = 0, which the close box prints as a pair of SLASHED ZEROS ('Ø.ØØ'), read 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and the two conventions are identical here. Schedule A prints FOUR columns (Date / Name of Contributor / City and Zip Code / Amount) with NO in-kind checkbox column; no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind; the Summary Page carries no in-kind line and no compound '+Inkind' cell. Both conventions were tested on both sides and give 11,215.93 and 11,722.37, so neither convention explains the Schedule A footer divergence — the cause is a scope error in the footers, traced in recon.contributions.detail.

THE ONE THAT MATTERED: p2 row 4's amount reads '3,814.43' at 200 dpi and '3,314.43' at 1200 dpi — the second glyph is the same zigzag 3 the filer writes in the thousands position of the same cell, and the page's arithmetic confirms it (the four rows then sum to Box B exactly, while 3,814.43 gives a figure printed nowhere). itemized.notes: FORM CHARACTERISATION (2026 stock, ninth specimen) — variant modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on every page, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. Four pages, summary LAST, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this document. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and Zip Code' (the Bowles/Herrin/Forbush/Evans/Tribe blank, not the 'Address and Zip Code' one Voeks and Smith used). Schedule B carries the real Purpose column and the filer used it on every row. Both schedules are boxed 15-row grids printing their own two footers; the Summary Page prints A, B/C, D/E, F and an UNLETTERED close box. Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is ticked, the amendment question is ticked 'No'. WHOLLY HANDWRITTEN on the printed form. CLERK RECEIPT STAMP: a two-colour 'Received / MAY 1 4 2026 / In Person / Utah County Clerk' stamp on the cover, agreeing with the filer's own report date. FOLIATION is continuous counting the cover (Pages 1-4) with no 'of N' component. *** THE ONE THING A LATER READER MUST NOT MISS: SCHEDULE A'S TWO PRINTED FOOTERS CARRY THE WRONG FIGURE. *** Both print 11,722.37, which is Box F (Subtotal before Expenditures = Box A + Box B) and not the contributions total; the four contribution rows sum to 11,215.93, exactly Box B, and the gap of 506.44 is exactly Box A. The rows are right, the footers are a scope error by the filer, the attribution is unique from the document's own boxes, and nothing was changed. Schedule B has no such problem — its footers, Box D and Box E all print 11,722.37 and the nine rows reproduce it to the cent. The summary ladder is otherwise fully self-consistent: 506.44 + 11,215.93 = 11,722.37 and F - D = 0, printed as a pair of SLASHED ZEROS in the close box and read 0 under the repo-wide zero-glyph ruling. *** EVERY DATE ON BOTH SCHEDULES IS A BARE M/D WITH NO YEAR *** (1/6, 1/17, 1/27, 3/14, 4/4, 4/17, 4/22, 5/1). All thirteen are kept verbatim with needs_review=1 and NO year is filled in from the report date, per the frozen per-row rule — even though the cover, the clerk stamp and the Summary Page's own Date of Report ('5/14/2026') all put the filing squarely in 2026. THREE NAME FORMS IN ONE DOCUMENT, all recorded: the cover's Name of Candidate box reads 'Rodney Mann', the affirmation line and every inner sheet's candidate box read 'Rodney W Mann', and index.csv's channel label is 'Rod Mann'. THE PAGE FACE GOVERNS; the fullest page-face form is 'Rodney W Mann' and it is what the contribution rows carry. The OFFICE BOX is handwritten 'County Commission B' — it names a seat letter but not the word 'Seat', and it corroborates index.csv's 'County Commission Seat B' from the page. REDACTION — the fourth instance in this chunk of a '_Redacted' filing that publishes the candidate's own address: the county blacked out the cover's EMAIL cell (immediately below the phone number, which was left in the clear) and the signature block, and left the full home street address, city, state and zip visible. Nothing from that row is carried into this record. Neither schedule carries any redaction, and no DONOR address exists to redact because the only donor is the candidate and the 2026 'City and Zip Code' column asks only for a city and a zip.
